foot:
This report lists filesystem junk only. For WinSxS run Dism.exe /Online /Cleanup-Image /AnalyzeComponentStore; for Volume Shadow Copy run vssadmin list shadowstorage. Antivirus-protected paths (e.g. QQPCMgr *.db) are excluded automatically.
Deletion is a separate explicit step: delete_safe.py --targets targets.json (dry-run by default, add --confirm after user review).
